selection: medicine validation package macro R@1, then macro MRR; final test only after configuration and checkpoints are frozen
historical_exposure: Medicine and external baseline results have prior development exposure; no claim of historically blind evaluation
train_reference_scope: positive reference designs of training packages only; no validation or test design participates in training

additional_training_regime.name: medicine_catalog
additional_training_regime.scope: Full fixed reference catalog supplies natural Top-128 negatives, matching the original rebut candidate setting. Only training-photo labels are optimized; held photos remain excluded.
additional_training_regime.reporting: Separate catalog-visible and strict unseen-reference tables; never present catalog-visible results as unseen-reference training.

additional_adapter_location_ablation.reason: Test whether the 3584D hidden adapter is necessary relative to conditioning existing embeddings; selected only on medicine validation.

gallery: complete existing gallery with existing dataset-specific deduplication and relevance
candidate_source: natural frozen ColNomic 7B ranking; no oracle insertion

roma.cache: copied descriptor containers; parity checked against uncached forward and official match API

precision_amendment.reason: After correcting mutable descriptor-cache reuse, FP16 is finite and exactly agrees with the same-precision uncached implementation on audited pairs. Representative FP32 versus FP16 mass differences are below 0.0002; every generated pair remains finite checked.

forb_compute_budget.note: Same trained checkpoint. All queries retained; first-stage full gallery. Candidate K sweep is reported on medicine; GroZi/MILK also have up to 128 cached candidates.

adjustment_policy: Additional variants may be developed on medicine train/validation and must be logged before test/transfer evaluation
artifacts: final checkpoints, compact predictions, result tables, one final report, reusable feature caches, and reproducible code

additional_strong_baseline.name: validation-calibrated BM25 + image fusion
additional_strong_baseline.selection: medicine validation package macro R@1 then macro MRR

budget_ablation_scope: 25/50/100 percent query-label budgets with the full training-design negative catalog fixed; not a reduction of the design catalog.

patch_condition_ablation.purpose: Use reference-conditioned query patch support u rather than a scalar M. Same hidden adapter size; normalization from eligible training pairs only.
patch_condition_ablation.replication_policy: Replicate promising validation variants before test/transfer selection.

strict_replication.reason: Seed 17 improved validation R@1 to 78.91% from RAW 74.83%; replicate before checkpoint selection and all new-model test/transfer scoring.

practical_ocr_fusion_comparison.rule: Weighted reciprocal rank fusion with BM25 over the complete canonical gallery; offset 60
practical_ocr_fusion_comparison.selection: medicine validation only; same calibration for RAW image baseline
practical_ocr_fusion_comparison.scope: medicine validation and test; visual-only frozen transfer remains separate

forb_resampling.relevance: official multiple positives preserved; official AP denominator preserved

intervention_scope.post_constant: Set standardized adapter condition to zero; frozen RoMa/MaxSim features otherwise unchanged.
intervention_scope.post_shuffled: Permute scalar or per-patch support among physical candidate IDs before prefix selection.
intervention_scope.external_mass: Change the global coverage summaries used by the head (M or U/V) and recompute dependent products; spatially weighted content remains fixed, so this is not complete removal of RoMa.

foreground_baselines.automatic: Existing SAM3 highest-confidence package mask, white background, ColNomic 7B; same full gallery and current inventory.
foreground_baselines.mixed_boxes: Historical human_boxes route contains 200 human-confirmed boxes and 800 retained SAM3 default boxes. Report as a mixed-region diagnostic, not a fully human-annotated upper bound or a fully automatic method.

nonlinear_head_control.reason: Validation shows tiny linear heads compete with token adapters; control for nonlinear scoring capacity with approximately matched parameter counts. No new-model test or transfer scores inspected.
nonlinear_head_control.inputs: Relative RAW/M/L0 and train-standardized log mass of candidate and RAW winner

strict_replication.reason: Best strict external-head validation macro R@1/MRR; replicate stochastic head before model selection and test/transfer.

catalog_replication.reason: Best catalog external-head validation macro R@1/MRR among current runs; repeat before checkpoint selection and all new-model test/transfer scoring.

evaluation_scheduling.definition: Contiguous query batches over the full unchanged manifest. All batches are merged; duplicate/missing IDs and checkpoint signatures are checked. No model or metric is changed.
evaluation_scheduling.idle_gpu_work: Training queues may fill frozen FORB geometry one query at a time when no training job can be claimed. The same GPU lease protects both kinds of work; training is checked again after each query. No labels or test metrics are used for this scheduling.

reader_interventions.compressed: Not applicable; omitted rather than interpreting an ignored argument as evidence of invariance.

directional_overlap_control.reason: Real photos show partial package surfaces while reference art can show unfolded designs. Test each direction of frozen RoMa coverage and a learned asymmetric combination.
directional_overlap_control.inputs: Existing cached mean query/reference support; no new matching or teacher fitting.
directional_overlap_control.selection: Medicine validation only; declared before any new-model test/transfer evaluation.

catalog_loss_ablation.reason: Catalog ADDITIVE4 CE reaches validation R@1 80.95% versus COST 77.55%; add the same loss comparison for the original hidden adapter before new-model test/transfer. Training scope, architecture, seed and update budget remain fixed.

online_timing.query_selection: Uniform fixed seed 20260925 on medicine validation, without labels; identical queries for all methods.
online_timing.hardware: Same host and visible GPUs for all three methods.
online_timing.scope: Fresh query decode, ColNomic 7B encoding, full-gallery MaxSim, required RoMa, pooling and trained reranking; model loading recorded separately.

adapter_loss_selection.rule: Full-budget real-condition hidden adapters include both declared COST and CE runs in validation-only family selection. Constant/shuffled conditioning, width and training-budget ablations remain diagnostic. Seed summaries are separated by loss.
adapter_loss_selection.replication: If the newly declared catalog CE variant becomes the leading hidden-adapter validation result, repeat seeds 31 and 53 before freezing selection.

catalog_ce_replication.reason: Catalog CE seed 17 reaches validation R@1 80.27%, ahead of completed original hidden COST runs at 78.23%; execute the declared replication policy before any new-model test/transfer evaluation.

gradient_replay_correction.correction: Sparse VJP recomputes complete original forward candidate batches containing active derivatives, retaining batch and reference-padding shapes. Model, objective and inference are unchanged.
gradient_replay_correction.evidence: Regression test matches dense objective gradients; 30 real updates on the affected GPU type have zero corrected replay error. The intermittent production mismatch did not recur in fresh legacy audit processes.
gradient_replay_correction.historical: Earlier accepted updates remain within the same guard. Failed updates are never applied; existing valid checkpoints are retained.

development_freeze.scope: Declared training variants are closed. Complete all runs and validation before automatically freezing checkpoints, calibrating OCR fusion on validation, and dispatching test/transfer. Numerical failures may be repaired without test-driven model selection.

forb_hidden_parity_correction.finding: Single-device shortcut differs from the frozen baseline on 91 FORB queries. On audited examples the original sharded encoder on the original GPU class restores agreement below 3e-8. No claim about the deeper kernel-level cause.
forb_hidden_parity_correction.action: Regenerate only mismatching/missing hidden states with the original sharded encoder and unchanged 1e-6 parity guard. Baseline vectors, rankings, candidates, labels and trained models remain unchanged. No affected pooled features or new-model predictions existed.
